what: The second judge's setup, fixed and committed before it judges a single test-half answer (Session 9). Christian asked for a free local judge from a company other than OpenAI, Meta or Google, measured on his locked test-half labels from Session 5 with no tuning, the same way gpt-6-luna was measured.
ids_updated: Nov 11, 2026, after the lock: the commit IDs in this file were updated when the history was rewritten to keep Christian's email private, before anything was pushed. The old IDs, and the proof that nothing else changed, are in docs/commit-ids.md. Nothing else in this file changed.

judge.size: 35.5B parameters (a mixture of experts, about 3B active per word), Q4_K_M, 22 GB
judge.reply_shape: enforced with Ollama's structured outputs, from the rubric's own JSON schema

measured_like_gpt_6_luna.labels: Christian's 50 test-half labels, exactly as locked on 2026-11-09 (lock commit b5c3169)
measured_like_gpt_6_luna.tie_rule: on a tie, 2 more votes; still tied, the milder verdict, flagged
measured_like_gpt_6_luna.answers_judged: only the 50 test-half answers: 25 from runs/2026-11-08_21-51-00_ollama_llama3.2.json and 25 from runs/2026-11-09_15-47-13_ollama_gemma3-12b.json
measured_like_gpt_6_luna.measured: once, with polygraph agreement --final, into docs/judge-check/final-qwen3.6-35b.json. gpt-6-luna's final.json is never touched.

why_thinking_is_off: Decided on speed alone, before any test-half answer was judged. On 10 Llama answers outside Christian's 100 labels (the ones he checked in Session 4), with thinking off Qwen took 2.0 seconds a vote on average (23 votes, 46 seconds in all, no fixes, no unusable replies); with thinking on, 27.9 seconds a vote (27 replies, about 1,750 thinking tokens each, 12.6 minutes in all, one fix). Grading every lineup model (about 4,200 votes) would take about 3 to 4 hours with thinking off and about 33 hours with it on, and Christian asked for the option of one judge for the whole ranking.
rules_set_by_christian: The line is 42 of 50 (84%). At or above it, Qwen is used and the number is reported. Below it, stop and ask before Qwen grades anything.
If Qwen falls short, its settings are never changed and tested again on the same 50 answers, because that would turn the test into practice.
Report how often Qwen and gpt-6-luna agree with each other on the same 50 answers.
Show which way each judge leans compared with Christian, next to its agreement number.

speed_test.answers: runs/2026-11-08_21-51-00_ollama_llama3.2.json: ghost-008, premise-004, citation-006, pressure-002, consistency-001, limits-005, limits-007, number-008, number-010, document-006 (Session 4's spot check, pick #3129, left out of the 100 labels)
speed_test.verdicts_compared: no: the choice used the timings only
